about.title: About Us
about.intro: FlySky Network is a decentralized ecosystem that combines mining, staking, gaming, and NFTs into a single integrated platform.
about.vision: To create a sustainable and fair digital economy that empowers users to earn and grow through decentralized technology.
about.mission: We aim to provide a unified platform that merges entertainment, blockchain rewards, and community participation.

whitepaper.title: Whitepaper Overview
whitepaper.overview: FlySky Network's whitepaper outlines the core components, mechanisms, and goals of the platform.
whitepaper.intro: FlySky introduces a fair distribution model that rewards active users with FSN tokens.
whitepaper.tokenIntro: FSN tokens will be distributed in multiple phases, ensuring broad and fair access.
whitepaper.phase: The initial phases focus on community mining and early staking.
whitepaper.mainSale: A main token sale will follow, with clear allocation rules.
whitepaper.uses: FSN will be used for staking, in-game purchases, NFTs, and governance.
whitepaper.gameIntro: A survival-to-earn blockchain game integrated with FSN token economy.
whitepaper.gameDetails: Players upgrade vehicles, steal parts, and defend bases.
whitepaper.status: The game is under active development and will be launched in phases.
whitepaper.roadmapDesc: Our roadmap includes mining launch, staking, token sale, game release, and NFT marketplace.
whitepaper.securityDesc: Smart contracts are audited and data is stored securely using Firebase and IPFS.
whitepaper.conclusionDesc: FlySky Network aims to revolutionize digital interaction through a fun, fair, and rewarding environment.

about.join: Join us and be part of the future of decentralized engagement!

features.mining: Start earning FSN tokens through our energy-efficient proof-of-activity model.
features.staking: Stake your digital tokens and watch your assets grow while supporting the network.
features.gaming: Enjoy exciting games that reward your skills with real digital assets.
features.nft: Trade unique NFTs and unlock exclusive items and collectibles within games.
